card.name: Partitive nouns before "of"
card.fires_on: Collective or partitive nouns like "subset" and "combination" right after "a", where "of" is expected next. Seen in label text about patient groups or treatment mixes.

modes.label: A subset of patients
modes.description: The word "subset" after "A" at the start of a sentence about some patients having recurrence.
modes.example: Patients experienced relief of symptoms upon discontinuation of the medication. A<< subset>> of patients experienced a recurrence of symptoms when

modes.label: A combination of these
modes.description: The word "combination" after "or a" ending a list of options or factors.
modes.example: targeted therapy, or a<< combination>> of these treatment techniques.

card.writes: It pushes the word "of" (and its equivalents in other languages) as the next word.
card.plain: It spots words like "subset" or "combination" that are almost always followed by "of".
